readiness_scope: bounded follow-up research may be proposed; does not authorize training or a new experiment

decision.meaning: single-fragment frozen-feature association; not an ink detector, not proof of chemistry or transfer to downsampled T5

verification.bootstrap_scope: 10/2000 draws per feature/cohort independently regenerated; all saved draw quantiles checked
verification.limitations: Registration subpixel error not independently measured. C is lack of established signal, not proof of equivalence to chance.
